claims.claim: Capital One completed its acquisition of Discover Financial Services (owner of Diners Club International) effective May 18, 2025, under a merger agreement dated February 19, 2024.
claims.quote: Effective May 18, 2025 (the “Closing Date”), Capital One Financial Corporation, a Delaware corporation (“Capital One” or the “Company”), completed its previously announced acquisition
claims.title: Form 8-K, Capital One Financial Corp, Item 2.01 Completion of Acquisition
claims.publisher: U.S. SEC EDGAR (Capital One Financial Corp)
claims.label: Verified
claims.note: Discover merged into Capital One and Discover Bank into Capital One, N.A.; exchange ratio 1.0192 COF shares per DFS share. DGN and dinersclub.com footers still show © 2026 DFS Services LLC / Diners Club International Ltd.

claims.claim: Diners Club International reports 44 issuers, counted as franchises with active Network Participation Agreements or Sublicense NPAs and cards in force in market.
claims.quote: DCI Issuers included in total count have active Network Participation Agreements (NPA) or Sublicense NPAs which authorize them to issue DCI products
claims.title: About Diners Club | Diners Club International
claims.label: Vendor
claims.note: Headline figure on page: '44 ISSUERS'. The licensing vehicle is the NPA / Sublicense NPA, i.e. franchise model. Page copyright 2026; postdates Capital One close.

claims.claim: Discover Network and Diners Club International are collectively accepted in more than 185 countries and territories, based on an average of 2023-2025 internal transaction data.
claims.quote: Discover Network and Diners Club International are collectively accepted in more than 185 countries and territories based on Internal Discover Transaction Data
claims.title: About Diners Club | Diners Club International
claims.label: Vendor
claims.note: The Uzcard press release (Jan 2026) says 'over 190 countries and territories' using data through 2024; see contradictions.

claims.claim: Diners Club states its global payment network facilitated $634B in transaction volume in 2025, though the footnote describes the figure as total volume in 2024 and 2025.
claims.quote: our global payment network which facilitated $634B in transaction volume 3 in 2025 with acceptance at millions of merchants 4
claims.title: About Diners Club | Diners Club International
claims.label: Vendor
claims.note: Footnote 3 reads 'Internal Discover Network Volume Data, total volume in 2024 and 2025' - ambiguous whether $634B is one year or two; footnote 4 cites The Nilson Report #1298, December 2025. The figure is Discover Network-wide, not DCI alone.

claims.claim: Diners Club International dates itself to 1950, more than 75 years, as the world's first multipurpose charge card.
claims.quote: What started with a forgotten wallet became the world's first multipurpose charge card—and has grown into an iconic and trusted brand that's spent 75 years
claims.title: About Diners Club International: Globally Recognized Payments Network | Discover Network
claims.label: Vendor
claims.note: dinersclub.com/about-us likewise says 'Since 1950' and '75+ YEARS'.

claims.claim: Discover Global Network's page on Diners Club says DCI has issuers in 35+ countries, a different framing from the 44 issuers on dinersclub.com.
claims.quote: Diners Club International is a globally recognized payments network and premium issuing brand. Diners Club International has issuers in 35+ countries.
claims.title: About Diners Club International: Globally Recognized Payments Network | Discover Network
claims.label: Vendor
claims.note: Same NPA/Sublicense-NPA footnote as dinersclub.com. 44 issuers in 35+ countries is consistent if some countries have more than one licensee, but the two sites headline different numbers.

claims.claim: Diners Club is accepted at more than 1.2 million ATMs in over 130 countries and territories, per Discover, DCI, PULSE and RBR data.
claims.quote: Diners Club is accepted at more than 1.2M ATMs in over 130 countries and territories.
claims.title: Diners Club International® Issuing | Discover Network
claims.label: Vendor
claims.note: Footnote: 'Discover Network, Diners Club International, PULSE, and RBR Market Deployment Database.' No date on the ATM figure.

claims.claim: In January 2026 Discover described the combined Discover/DCI network as connecting 378+ million cards with acceptance in over 190 countries and territories, using data through 2024.
claims.quote: Discover Network is part of a global payment network that connects 378+ million cards worldwide 1 with acceptance in over 190 countries and territories 2
claims.title: UZCARD and Discover® Network Announce Strategic Alliance to Expand Global Payment Access in Uzbekistan
claims.label: Vendor
claims.note: Footnotes: cards include open cards on Discover Network, DCI and network alliances per RBR Data Services as of 2024; countries per internal transaction data through 2024. Quote attributed to Matt Sloan, VP international markets at Discover. Postdates Capital One close.

claims.claim: Diners Club International's issuing model is an exclusive-issuer franchise per market, with non-exclusive issuers in select markets.
claims.quote: Become an exclusive issuer* of this trusted brand to grow your business and deliver a differentiated offering. * Non-exclusive issuer in select markets
claims.title: Diners Club International® Issuing | Discover Network
claims.label: Vendor
claims.note: dinersclub.com routes consumers to 'the website for your local Club', confirming country-level franchisees front the brand.

claims.claim: For issuers, DCI's catalogue covers premium, co-branded, prepaid and debit consumer products, commercial card programs with expense management, plus contactless/chip and authentication and security products from the Discover stack.
claims.quote: Attract a wide variety of prospects with premium, co-branded, prepaid and debit card offerings.
claims.title: Diners Club International® Issuing | Discover Network
claims.label: Vendor
claims.note: Page also lists issuer support: 'Strategic support and guidance', 'Product co-creation', 'Turnkey marketing programs with local flexibility', 'Market research collaboration'. Tokenisation, fraud (3DS ProtectBuy, Stored Token Services, Enhanced Decisioning) and D-PAS EMV are DGN-level products in the site menu, not DCI-specific.

claims.claim: DCI value-added loyalty and engagement programs for issuers are airport lounge access and privileges, Diners Club Destinations (content/experiences) and Together for Change (CSR).
claims.quote: Our global destinations program curates and creates features and content to inspire exploration, enhance the Clubmember lifestyle and keep them engaged
claims.title: Diners Club International® Issuing | Discover Network
claims.label: Vendor
claims.note: Also: 'Together for Change, our corporate social responsibility program'. Cheers by Diners Club (cheers.dinersclub.com) is a cardholder content site.

claims.claim: DCI's commercial product set, delivered through local issuers, comprises SMB, corporate and multinational cards plus cardless Virtual Card Numbers, Corporate Travel Accounts and Travel Services Accounts, with Diners Club Tracker and File Services as spend-data tools.
claims.quote: Virtual Card Number Travel Services Account Corporate Travel Account
claims.title: Diners Club® Commercial Products | Discover Network
claims.label: Vendor
claims.note: dinersclub.com/businesses/ describes Diners Club Tracker ('Custom dashboard reporting') and File Services ('create outbound reports to send to corporate customers'); cardless page says the Travel Services Account 'is designed for Travel Service Providers to pay for wholesale travel services using one line of credit'. Availability is per country ('Check for availability').

claims.claim: dinersclub.com offers no self-serve partner onboarding; prospective issuers or partners are directed to a Contact Us form, and business products are surfaced by country search.
claims.quote: Want to partner with us? Let's work together to offer these products in your country. CONTACT US
claims.title: Business Payment Solutions | Diners Club International
claims.label: Vendor
claims.note: Contact Us links to https://servicecenter.discoverglobalnetwork.com/onlineform/contact-us (shared DGN form). 'We work with partners around the world to bring our card offerings to your business.'

claims.claim: In December 2025 Moorwand Ltd extended its DCI issuing licence in the UK to merchant acquiring, enabling UK merchants to accept Discover, DCI and 30 network alliance partners.
claims.quote: extending our long-standing collaboration beyond card issuing to now include merchant acquiring services in the UK market.
claims.title: Moorwand Ltd Expands Its Collaboration with Diners Club International® to Include Acquiring – Enabling UK Merchant Acceptance
claims.label: Vendor
claims.note: Shows a fintech/EMI, not a bank, holding DCI issuing and acquiring in a market. Postdates Capital One close. 30 alliances '*Based on signed Network Alliance Agreements'.

claims.claim: Discover Network claims 30+ network alliances, and alliance partners such as BC Card route their cardholders onto Discover Network, DCI and PULSE for international use.
claims.quote: allowing BC Card cardholders to utilize Discover Network, Diners Club International®, and PULSE® for international purchases and cash access outside of Korea.
claims.title: Reach and Acceptance | Discover Network
claims.label: Vendor
claims.note: Page lists alliance partners including AFS, Areeba, ATH/EVERTEC, Bcard, BC Card, Cabal, DinaCard, Dutch-Bangla Bank, Eazy, Elo, JCB, JONET, Network International, Mercury, NAPAS, NCCC, PayNet, Prosa, RuPay and more. 'Millions of locations' figure dated December 31, 2024.

claims.claim: Recent DCI franchise and program launches on Club Connections include ISX Financial's flykk debit card (Sept 2026), Sparkasse Pay in Slovenia, BRAC Bank's Emerald card in Bangladesh, and Nium and Pax2pay B2B travel cards.
claims.quote: Nium introduces the Diners Club International® Card, enhancing B2B payments for travel with greater flexibility, acceptance, and cost optimization.
claims.title: Press Releases | Diners Club Resources
claims.label: Vendor
claims.note: Relative dates on the listing: ISX/flykk '1 day ago', Moorwand '9 months ago', BRAC 'about 1 year ago', Nium and Pax2pay 'over 1 year ago'. Older items: Woori Card (Korea), Elo Diners Club (Brazil), VietinBank (Vietnam), Allinpay (Hong Kong acceptance), 2C2P (SE Asia e-commerce), Kazkommertsbank (Kazakhstan exclusive issuer/acquirer), BDO Unibank (Philippines), HDFC Bank co-brands (India).

claims.claim: Diners Club International issuer resources are gated behind a Log In on discoverglobalnetwork.com, available only to current DCI issuers.
claims.quote: Log In Note: Access available to current Diners Club International Issuers.
claims.title: Tools to Enable Payments | Discover Network
claims.label: Vendor
claims.note: Log In link resolves to https://discover.service-now.com/infonet (ServiceNow). Not readable without an account.

claims.claim: Acquirers, processors and merchants enabling Diners Club acceptance use the DGN EASI Portal for technical specifications, developer test card kits, product announcements and a Message Center to network operations; registration is required.
claims.quote: Our Enablement, Acceptance Support Info-center, (EASI) Portal, provides the resources needed to enable transactions in-store, online and in-app.
claims.title: Tools to Enable Payments | Discover Network
claims.label: Vendor
claims.note: Registration at https://www.discovereasi.com/easi/getregistration. Public IIN/BIN ranges page at /resources/payments-providers/bin-ranges/. There is no DCI-specific acquirer surface; DCI acceptance is enabled through Discover Global Network.

claims.claim: The Discover Developer Center (linked from dinersclub.com footer as 'Discover Dev Center') presents only a login form at its home page; no API documentation is readable without an account.
claims.quote: Discover Developer Center Account Locked Org Modal User Edit Success Password Expired Password Expired Conf User Invite Success Existing User Invite Success Log In Email
claims.title: Discover Developer Center
claims.label: Verified
claims.note: Redirects to /home. DGN get-started page says the Dev Center has 'APIs for: Payments Security Cardholder features'. Mentions of user invites suggest invite-based provisioning.

claims.claim: Discover Network's Service Center login page lists the client portals partners use: Fraud and Risk Center, EASI Portal (acquirers, acquirer processors, issuers), Advanced Payments Providers, Discover eCentral (merchants) and Discover Network Disputes Portal.
claims.quote: Other Client Portals Acquirers, Acquirer Processors and Issuers Log into the EASI Portal or Join Now Advanced Payments Providers Log in or Join Now
claims.title: Fraud and Risk Center Log In | Discover Network Service Center
claims.label: Verified
claims.note: Fraud/risk products enrolled via the portal: Account Incident Manager, Confirmed Fraud, Fraud Alerts, High Brand Risk. MFA required. All gated.

claims.claim: Club Connections (resources.dinersclub.com) is DCI's public, login-free news hub with Company News, Press Releases, Articles and Videos alongside cardholder travel content.
claims.quote: Diners Club Press Releases Read the latest press releases from Diners Club International and learn about new partnerships.
claims.title: Press Releases | Diners Club Resources
claims.label: Verified
claims.note: Readable without an account. Sections: /news, /press-releases, /article, /video, plus destination and dining content. The dinersclub.com Press page also offers a Media Kit and a downloadable Fact Sheet.

claims.claim: Diners Club operates an Online Dispute Resolution site at odr.dinersclub.com, a JavaScript app whose audience is not stated on the landing page.
claims.quote: Online Dispute Resolution You need to enable JavaScript to run this app.
claims.title: Online Dispute Resolution
claims.label: Verified
claims.note: Linked from the dinersclub.com footer ('Failed Transaction-India'), so likely the India-regulated cardholder complaint flow rather than a partner disputes tool.
